headline: Is my soulmate waiting for me to heal?
note:
FRAME: soulmate x keyword. NO PARTICULAR MAN EXISTS — the read must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴 The ad already tells her she is the problem, which is the best fit on the funnel for this method: the card acquits her, and the block is what is left.

⚠ SHE is the subject of beats 3-6. The return-mhf figures are all male, so he is DESCRIBED in beats 1-2 and retired there — never given intent or motion toward her, or a soulmate lander turns into reunion copy.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE anywhere in the read.

🔴 THE READ MAY NOT RULE ON HER HEALING IN EITHER DIRECTION. 'Yes, heal first' is the sentence BLAME_BANS pins as gating love on her fixing herself; 'no, you don't need to' is a verdict on her state. The read refuses the SEQUENCE, not the healing — nothing here denies, minimises or prescribes it.

⛔ NO HEALTH, THERAPY OR DIAGNOSIS LANGUAGE. No trauma, attachment, inner child, nervous system, shadow work.

⚠ MUST NOT RESTATE cards-heal-first. That one is asked about the SEQUENCE ('do I need to heal before'); this one is asked about WHO IS WAITING ON WHOM. The reads are written apart on that line.

a: You turned the Magician. You had nothing to go on, and your hand found the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. One is raised, the other points down, and both are busy.
You asked if your soulmate is waiting for you to heal. What catches me is that both hands are in the middle of something.
And yet nobody has come. And you've put the hold-up at your end.
Something turns up right where this would move. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and you found the calmest face in the deck.
He hangs upside down from one ankle. Look at his face, though — it's calm.
You asked if your soulmate is waiting for you to heal. What I'm reading is the rope, and the beam it runs up into.
Still, nobody has come. And you've made yourself the reason for the wait.
Whatever has hold of this holds it quietly. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing marked the backs, and you took the one travelling light.
Look at the bundle on his stick. It's small, and it's all he has.
You asked if your soulmate is waiting for you to heal. What I'm looking at is a bundle small enough to walk with.
But nobody has come. And you're still asking whether the delay is at your end.
Something sits at the point where this would start. I don't think any of it began with you.
Let me look closer at what it is…
